A bucket closes when the set of active buckets does not fit within the allowed storage engine cache size, or when the bucket catalog exceeds its memory allocation (default 2.5% of system memory). The docs point to collStats for reviewing this.

For any configuration of granularity parameters, the maximum size of a bucket is 1000 measurements or 125KB of data, whichever is lower. A new bucket is created when the metaField matches no active bucket, the timestamp is outside all active buckets' ranges, or the doc exceeds remaining size/count limits. High cardinality means many open buckets and so earlier closures.
